fails_if: `ErrataFieldEntry` stops requiring that a guarded `representation` correction's replacement literal is supplied by one of its `expected_records` alternatives
note: The listed record carries only the 'Source reference' alternative; the replacement is the literal of a peer alternative the entry does not list. message_contains: alternative field corrections require complete original guards and an existing source replacement literal
